use_cases.scenario: Statistical datasets account for a large share of general open-data portal holdings; users need better descriptions to discover and assess them across sectors.

Statistical institutions and general open-data portals exchange descriptions using different frameworks. Federated discovery should preserve useful meaning and provenance across these systems; observations themselves remain outside the metadata-catalogue scope.
